title: Paranal sky with comet
caption: The Milky Way and Comet 252P/LINEAR over the Paranal Residencia, Chile
celestial: Photograph taken at Paranal Observatory, Chile

recognition.text: Published in the ESO image archive. No published rating.

story: Above the lit dome of the Residencia at ESO's Paranal Observatory, the Milky Way stretches in a wide arc across the sky. Toward the left, near the horizon, is Comet 252P/LINEAR.

A comet is a small icy body that develops a fuzzy glow as it nears the Sun. On 22–23 March 2016 this one made only its fifth close approach to Earth on record. Although the dome in the foreground is lit, the Residencia produces no light pollution that would hamper the work of the telescopes.

The picture comes from ESO's Fulldome Expedition to Chile, in which a team of photographers gathered images for planetarium presentations. Fulldome images are made to be projected across the curved ceiling of a planetarium, surrounding the audience with the sky.

understand.summary: This is a ground-based photograph credited to ESO/P. Horálek, taken during ESO's Fulldome Expedition. The source does not publish camera, exposure or colour-processing details.
understand.eye: A camera gathering light over time can reveal a faint comet near the horizon that the eye might easily miss.
